title: Derivative of the reflected Gaussian distribution sum
statement: Let $\Phi(t)=\gamma((-�\infty,t])$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function. For every $x\in\mathbb R$, the function $t\mapsto\Phi(-t)+\Phi(t)$ is differentiable at $x$ with derivative $0$.
replaced: For the standard Gaussian distribution function $\Phi$, the function $t\mapsto\Phi(-t)+\Phi(t)$ has derivative zero at every $x\in\mathbb R$.
